scope: Three independent interventions, sequential immutable checkpoints. No pooled historical outcomes. Model tasks and execution bindings must be committed before model calls.

hypotheses.mechanism: On a rejected scoped patch, attach the exact current symbol/file and bounded neighboring read, distinguish symbol body/declaration from file-context patch, and explain that the entire batch is unapplied and based on original source. Never auto-read or relax guards.
hypotheses.measure: Local same failed requests then follow suggested reads/edits: successful precise recovery, guard preservation, response bytes. Model blocked retries and strict final task criteria before conditional resources.
hypotheses.comparison: Immutable reference vs F18; integrated Cline for fixed new multi-file tasks.
hypotheses.risk: Extra output or misleading stale hints. Advice is not observed edit coverage.

hypotheses.mechanism: Explicit signature-only symbol read, bound only returned signature bytes. Bodies remain available through the existing symbol route. No automatic hiding of body or type information.
hypotheses.measure: Actual result bytes and guard-preserving subsequent read/edit; model signature-route activation, omitted information/retries, strict task success and reconciled resources.
hypotheses.comparison: F18 vs F18+F19; same fixed caller migration requests, Cline integrated.
hypotheses.risk: Extra tool calls and lost behavioral context; a signature must never authorize replacing an unseen body.

hypotheses.mechanism: For supported pure Node project test invocations, add an invocation-owned event reporter alongside readable output. Count file-level case summaries, excluding empty workers and suites; bind report/runner/source/environment metadata, retaining unknown coverage/dependencies.
hypotheses.measure: Real empty/filter/mixed/path-named/failing/skipped/nested/interrupted controls, required-check fulfillment vs generic verification, model exposure and strict criteria.
hypotheses.comparison: F19 vs F19+F20 and integrated Cline; unknown reports cannot be retroactively upgraded.
hypotheses.risk: Reporter compatibility, option/lifecycle interference, incomplete events and overstating environment or dependency scope.

localDecision: Keep only mechanisms with zero false admission/guard bypass in meaningful controls; preserve adverse sensitivities and setup failures. Model evidence can reject efficiency hypotheses without rejecting necessary truthful accounting.

modelBudget.reservationPolicy: Sequential conservative reservation before every call. Missing cost reserves the full limit. Actual spend plus next reservation must fit the cap; retain any unexecuted rows. USD .24 is a new separate phase ceiling, not additional spend in the closed previous phase.

evidence: Known traces under scope-confirmation and validation-refresh-confirmation contain rejected scoped contexts; prior F17 model panel reads full types.ts vs ranges. F16 real Node diagnostics lose two legitimate path-named cases. Local improvements are not model success gains.
